entries.content: Finally got my refund after three weeks. Had to call back four times and reference my case number each time. The third rep actually escalated it properly to a supervisor who had authority to process it. Exhausting but eventually worked through official channels.

Most companies have tiered support structures. Frontline agents handle routine issues while supervisors and retention specialists have broader authority for exceptions. Documenting interactions with dates, names, and reference numbers strengthens escalation requests.
